sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》，今日报道。

sentences.en: In two explosive interviews, separated by a quarter century, Princess Diana and Meghan Markle forced the royal family to confront ugly truths about itself.
sentences.zh: 在相隔四分之一个世纪的两场爆炸性采访中，戴安娜王妃和梅根·马克尔迫使王室直面自身丑陋的真相。

sentences.en: My colleague, Sarah Lyle, on how, in the process, they encouraged British society to do the same.
sentences.zh: 我的同事萨拉·莱尔将讲述她们是如何在此过程中鼓励英国社会也做出同样的改变。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, March 11th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月11日，星期四。

sentences.en: Sarah, where were you in your career as a reporter when this now-famous interview with Diana, the
sentences.zh: 萨拉，当这位如今著名的威尔士王妃戴安娜的采访

sentences.en: Princess of Wales, first heirs?
sentences.zh: 首次播出时，你作为记者的职业生涯处于什么阶段？

sentences.en: So it was 1995, and I'd just moved to London from New York.
sentences.zh: 那是1995年，我刚从纽约搬到伦敦。

sentences.en: I'd gotten married to a British person, and I'd been assigned by the paper to cover an interview that Diana, the Princess of Wales,
sentences.zh: 我嫁给了一位英国人，报社指派我报道戴安娜王妃的采访，她是

sentences.en: wife of Prince Charles, the heir to the throne, was about to give on television about the state their marriage and her relationship to the British royal family.
sentences.zh: 王位继承人查尔斯王子的妻子，她即将通过电视讲述他们的婚姻状况以及她与英国王室的关系。

sentences.en: And here's what you need to understand about what was going on at the time.
sentences.zh: 关于当时的情况，你需要了解这一点。

sentences.en: Her marriage to Charles was in total disarray.
sentences.zh: 她与查尔斯的婚姻已经彻底破裂。

sentences.en: They had gotten married in 1981, but by this point, 14 years later, they were officially separated.
sentences.zh: 他们于1981年结婚，但到了14年后的这个时候，他们已经正式分居了。

sentences.en: She was still technically part of the royal family, but she was on the outside because she was officially separated from her husband.
sentences.zh: 从技术上讲，她仍然是王室成员，但由于与丈夫正式分居，她已被排斥在外。

sentences.en: And the tabloids were obsessed.
sentences.zh: 当时的小报对此非常痴迷。

sentences.en: They were full of gossip from both sides about things like how badly he treated her and how badly she behaved and her childishness and his coldness.
sentences.zh: 报纸上充斥着双方的流言蜚语，比如他对待她有多糟糕，她的行为有多糟糕，她的孩子气和他的冷漠等等。

sentences.en: So all of a sudden, we got this news that Diana's going to give this interview to the BBC and set the record straight from her perspective.
sentences.zh: 突然间，我们得到消息说戴安娜要接受BBC的采访，从她的角度澄清事实。

sentences.en: And so what actually happens in this interview?
sentences.zh: 那么，这次采访中到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: I desperately wanted to work.
sentences.zh: 我拼命地想工作。

sentences.en: I desperately love my husband, and I wanted to share everything together.
sentences.zh: 我拼命地爱着我的丈夫，我想和他分享一切。

sentences.en: And I thought that we were a very good team.
sentences.zh: 我以为我们是一个非常好的团队。

sentences.en: Well, she starts telling this extraordinary story of how horrible her marriage had been.
sentences.zh: 她开始讲述她那段糟糕透顶的婚姻，故事非常离奇。

sentences.en: Well, we had unique pressures put upon us, and we both tried our hardest to cover them up, but obviously it wasn't to be.
sentences.zh: 我们承受着独特的压力，我们俩都尽了最大努力去掩盖，但显然事与愿违。

sentences.en: She expected it to be a kind of fairy tale, and he was cold and distant and weird.
sentences.zh: 她曾期待这是一场童话，而他却冷漠、疏远且古怪。

sentences.en: And it wasn't just two people who didn't really get along who ended up drifting apart.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是两个合不来的人最终渐行渐远。

sentences.en: Around 1986, your husband renewed his relationship with Mrs. Camilla Parker Bowles.
sentences.zh: 大约在1986年，你丈夫恢复了他与卡米拉·帕克·鲍尔斯夫人的关系。
zh_words: 卡米拉·帕克·鲍尔斯夫人

sentences.en: Were you aware of that?
sentences.zh: 你当时知道吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I was.
sentences.zh: 是的，我知道。

sentences.en: But I wasn't in a position to do anything about it.
sentences.zh: 但我当时无能为力。

sentences.en: Her husband was already having an affair with his former girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫当时已经和他的前女友有了外遇。

sentences.en: What evidence did you have that their relationship was continuing, even though you were married?
sentences.zh: 尽管你们当时已婚，你有什么证据证明他们的关系仍在继续？

sentences.en: A woman's instinct is a very good one.
sentences.zh: 女人的直觉是非常准的。

sentences.en: Do you think Mrs. Parker Bowles was a factor in the breakdown of your marriage?
sentences.zh: 你认为帕克·鲍尔斯夫人是你婚姻破裂的一个因素吗？

sentences.en: Well, there were three of us in this marriage, so it was a bit crowded.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们的婚姻里有三个人，所以有点拥挤。

sentences.en: And the way she presented it in this interview was like, you just have to accept that a prince will have affairs, and that's part of the deal you're getting into.
sentences.zh: 她在采访中表达的方式就像是，你必须接受王子会有外遇，这是你所处境遇的一部分。

sentences.en: And what else did she say in this interview?
sentences.zh: 她在采访中还说了什么？

sentences.en: It's been suggested in some newspapers that you were left largely to cope with your new status on your own.
sentences.zh: 一些报纸曾暗示，你基本上是独自应对你的新身份。

sentences.en: Do you feel that was your experience?
sentences.zh: 你觉得那是你的真实经历吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I do, on reflection.
sentences.zh: 是的，回想起来，确实如此。

sentences.en: Well, she talked about how lonely she had been.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了自己曾经有多么孤独。

sentences.en: Here was a situation which hadn't ever happened before in history, in the sense that the media were everywhere, and here was a fairy story that everybody wanted to work.
sentences.zh: 这是一个历史上从未发生过的情况，媒体无处不在，而这是一个每个人都希望成真的童话故事。

sentences.en: And so it was isolating.
sentences.zh: 所以这让人感到孤立。

sentences.en: She also said that she self-harmed.
sentences.zh: 她还说她曾自残。

sentences.en: According to press reports, it was suggested that it was around this time, things became so difficult that you actually tried to injure yourself.
sentences.zh: 据新闻报道，有人暗示大约在那个时候，情况变得如此困难，以至于你真的试图伤害自己。

sentences.en: Is that true?
sentences.zh: 这是真的吗？

sentences.en: When no one listens to you, or you feel no one's listening to you, all sorts of things start to happen.
sentences.zh: 当没有人听你说话，或者你觉得没有人听你说话时，各种事情就开始发生了。

sentences.en: And nobody was talking about that back then.
sentences.zh: 那时根本没人谈论这些。

sentences.en: So, yes, I did inflict upon myself.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我确实伤害了自己。

sentences.en: I didn't like myself.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢自己。

sentences.en: I was ashamed because I couldn't cope with the pressures.
sentences.zh: 我感到羞耻，因为我无法应对这些压力。

sentences.en: She had been very bulimic.
sentences.zh: 她曾患有严重的暴食症。

sentences.en: I had bulimia for a number of years.
sentences.zh: 我患暴食症已经好几年了。

sentences.en: And that's like a secret disease you inflicted upon yourself because your self-esteem is too low ebb, and you don't think you're worthy or valuable.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一种秘密疾病，你因为自尊心太低，认为自己不值得或没有价值，而对自己施加这种伤害。

sentences.en: And it's a repetitive pattern, which is very destructive to yourself.
sentences.zh: 这是一种重复性的模式，对自己非常有破坏性。

sentences.en: No one had really talked about it publicly before, and no one of her caliber, of her position.
sentences.zh: 以前从未有人公开谈论过这个问题，更不用说像她这样地位的人了。

sentences.en: For instance, you have so much pain inside yourself that you try and hurt yourself on the outside because you want help, but it's the wrong help you're asking for.
sentences.zh: 例如，你内心有太多的痛苦，以至于你试图在身体上伤害自己，因为你想要帮助，但你寻求帮助的方式错了。

sentences.en: People just didn't speak like that in England at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时在英国，人们根本不会那样说话。

sentences.en: They just didn't talk about their probleMs. And when you marry into the royal family, you're meant to just become a royal family member.
sentences.zh: 他们就是不谈论自己的问题。当你嫁入王室时，你理应成为一名王室成员。

sentences.en: You're not really supposed to have a personality of your own.
sentences.zh: 你不应该有自己的个性。

sentences.en: You're not supposed to do things differently from the way they do them.
sentences.zh: 你不应该做与他们不同的事情。

sentences.en: You're not supposed to draw too much attention to yourself.
sentences.zh: 你不应该引起太多的关注。

sentences.en: I mean, she presents herself as being from a very different emotional mindset as them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她表现出的情感心态与他们截然不同。

sentences.en: It frightened them that she was unhappy.
sentences.zh: 她的不快乐让他们感到害怕。

sentences.en: They don't really do unhappy in the royal family, and they certainly don't complain.
sentences.zh: 王室里的人并不真正理解“不快乐”，他们当然也不会抱怨。

sentences.en: And so by doing this interview, she's very publicly making the royal family confront what she's saying and her struggles with her mental health.
sentences.zh: 所以通过这次采访，她非常公开地迫使王室面对她所说的话以及她在心理健康方面的挣扎。

sentences.en: And given that they tried to push it under the rug all this time, it was extremely upsetting to them to hear it publicly aired like this.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他们一直试图掩盖这一切，听到这些被公开曝光，他们感到非常不安。

sentences.en: So she's not only describing a profound unhappiness, she's describing a profound unhappiness that comes in part at the hands of this pretty uncaring, unsympathetic royal family.
sentences.zh: 所以她不仅是在描述一种深切的不幸，她还在描述这种深切的不幸在某种程度上是由这个相当冷漠、缺乏同情心的王室造成的。

sentences.en: And it's not trying to alleviate her pain, even as she is telling them that she is in such pain.
sentences.zh: 即使她在告诉他们自己有多痛苦时，他们也没有试图减轻她的痛苦。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Sarah, how does this interview, which as you said, is quite uncharacteristic in the British tradition and imagination, how does it land inside the UK when it airs in 1995?
sentences.zh: 萨拉，正如你所说，这次采访在英国传统和想象中是非常不寻常的，那么它在1995年播出时在英国国内引起了怎样的反响？

sentences.en: It was completely shocking, and it really divided people.
sentences.zh: 这完全令人震惊，而且确实让人们产生了分歧。

sentences.en: I mean, people who were sort of establishment people, older people, men, you know, all sympathized with Charles, and they
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那些属于建制派的人、老年人、男性，你知道，他们都同情查尔斯，他们

sentences.en: sympathized with the notion of this long-running establishment monarchy not having to deal with outsiders criticizing it.
sentences.zh: 同情这种长期存在的建制派君主制不必应对局外人批评的观念。

sentences.en: They thought that the rudeness and the mischief of coming in and saying all these things was a horrible thing to do to your in-laws and a horrible thing to do to this
sentences.zh: 他们认为这种粗鲁和恶作剧的行为，跑出来说这些话，是对姻亲的一种可怕行为，也是对这个

sentences.en: institution that in some ways they felt was the glue that held society together.
sentences.zh: 机构的一种可怕行为，在某种程度上，他们认为这是维系社会的粘合剂。

sentences.en: So in this version, she betrays the monarchy and, by extension, a kind of fundamental aspect of
sentences.zh: 所以在这个版本中，她背叛了君主制，进而背叛了

sentences.en: British society.
sentences.zh: 英国社会的一种基本面。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And she's also whining in a way that Brits hate.
sentences.zh: 而且她还以一种英国人讨厌的方式发牢骚。

sentences.en: They don't want to hear people talk about their probleMs. It really was all stiff up her lip, don't complain, you know, sit there with rain
sentences.zh: 他们不想听人们谈论他们的问题。这真的是一种“咬紧牙关，不要抱怨”的态度，你知道，坐在那里，雨

sentences.en: pouring on your head freezing and just say, you know, it was sunny five minutes ago, we got the best of the day.
sentences.zh: 淋在头上，冻得发抖，却还要说，你知道，五分钟前还是晴天，我们度过了美好的一天。

sentences.en: But a whole other segment of society, you know, younger women, people who were unhappy in
sentences.zh: 但社会的另一部分人，你知道，年轻女性，在爱情中不快乐的人，

sentences.en: love, people who had struggled with mental health issues, people who maybe had eating problems or
sentences.zh: 在心理健康问题上挣扎的人，可能患有饮食问题或

sentences.en: other problems, all those people thought, well done you, you know, for speaking out.
sentences.zh: 其他问题的人，所有这些人都会想，你做得好，你知道，因为你敢于说出来。

sentences.en: We sympathize with you.
sentences.zh: 我们同情你。

sentences.en: We think you're wonderful.
sentences.zh: 我们认为你很棒。

sentences.en: And you're a brave person for talking about yourself in this way.
sentences.zh: 你是一个勇敢的人，因为你以这种方式谈论自己。

sentences.en: Of those two very divergent views of this interview, which one prevails?
sentences.zh: 在这两种对这次采访截然不同的观点中，哪一种占了上风？

sentences.en: Well, I think both those strands were sort of buzzing around in people's opinions after the interview.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为采访后，这两种观点都在人们的舆论中回荡。

sentences.en: And as a result of the interview, the queen basically told the two of them they had to get divorced.
sentences.zh: 由于这次采访，女王基本上告诉他们俩必须离婚。

sentences.en: It was unacceptable to have a married couple who were married, those separated, speaking in public like this about each other.
sentences.zh: 让一对已经分居的已婚夫妇在公开场合这样谈论彼此是不可接受的。

sentences.en: So then the divorce lands Diane in this sort of weird limbo period, because she's basically been kicked out of the royal family and feeling abandoned by them.
sentences.zh: 所以离婚让戴安娜陷入了一种奇怪的边缘状态，因为她基本上被踢出了王室，并感到被他们抛弃了。

sentences.en: They stripped her of her royal title, so she couldn't be known as her royal highness anymore, which doesn't sound like a big deal, but was a big deal to her at the time.
sentences.zh: 他们剥夺了她的王室头衔，所以她不能再被称为“殿下”了，这听起来没什么大不了的，但在当时对她来说是一件大事。

sentences.en: She didn't go around with royal security anymore.
sentences.zh: 她不再有王室安保随行了。

sentences.en: She was sort of out on her own.
sentences.zh: 她基本上是孤身一人。

sentences.en: And then of course, in 1997, just two years later, she's in Paris with her boyfriend, and ends up in a car speeding away from the paparazzi
sentences.zh: 然后当然，在1997年，仅仅两年后，她和男友在巴黎，最终坐进了一辆为了躲避狗仔队而超速行驶的汽车

sentences.en: being chased, and is in a terrible car accident, and both she and her boyfriend are killed.
sentences.zh: 被追赶，发生了一场可怕的车祸，她和她的男友都丧生了。

sentences.en: And that's when you saw this incredible moment in the history of modern Britain, where all this emotion spilled out, and there'd never been a country where emotion spilled out.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，你看到了现代英国历史上一个不可思议的时刻，所有的情感都倾泻而出，而这个国家以前从未有过情感如此倾泻的情况。

sentences.en: Can we please have your reaction to the news?
sentences.zh: 我们能听听你对这个消息的反应吗？

sentences.en: I feel like everyone else in this country today utterly devastated.
sentences.zh: 我觉得今天这个国家的每个人都感到无比悲痛。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, people were weeping in the streets.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，人们在街上哭泣。

sentences.en: Everybody loved them!
sentences.zh: 每个人都爱他们！

sentences.en: This morning, even by the time they came to change the guard at Buckingham Palace, the pavement outside was already a sea of flowers.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，甚至在白金汉宫换岗的时候，外面的路面上已经是一片花的海洋。

sentences.en: And, you know, thousands of people came and left flowers at all the royal palaces, even the one she didn't live at.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，成千上万的人来到所有的王室宫殿献花，甚至是她没住过的那些。

sentences.en: They were leaving the flowers in Buckingham Palace.
sentences.zh: 他们把花留在了白金汉宫。

sentences.en: I was looking at your bouquets there.
sentences.zh: 我正在看你的花束。

sentences.en: Would you read what you've said on the card?
sentences.zh: 你能读一下卡片上写了什么吗？

sentences.en: What I've said on the card.
sentences.zh: 卡片上写的内容。

sentences.en: It's not just what you've done for us that makes us love you so.
sentences.zh: 让我们如此爱你的，不仅仅是你为我们所做的一切。

sentences.en: It's all the joy of who you are, the friend who comes to know.
sentences.zh: 而是你作为一个人所带来的所有快乐，那个我们所认识的朋友。

sentences.en: It's a dreadful time, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这是一个可怕的时刻，不是吗？

sentences.en: And people were so sorry.
sentences.zh: 人们感到非常遗憾。

sentences.en: They said, you know, we didn't appreciate her when she was alive, and she was essentially killed by this family that was cold and unfeeling.
sentences.zh: 他们说，你知道，她在世时我们没有珍惜她，而她本质上是被这个冷漠无情的家庭害死的。

sentences.en: And what ended up happening then was also extraordinary, because the royal family never does anything that it hasn't done before.
sentences.zh: 后来发生的事情也非同寻常，因为王室从不做它以前没做过的事情。

sentences.en: It hates change.
sentences.zh: 它讨厌改变。

sentences.en: And so for the first few days after the death, they refused to make a statement.
sentences.zh: 所以在她去世后的最初几天，他们拒绝发表声明。

sentences.en: I mean, all these people here today are showing the strength of the nation, and she hasn't said anything, the Queen.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，今天在这里的所有人都在展示这个国家的力量，而女王却什么也没说。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: And as Prince Charles, well, I think there's not a lot he can say, really, is there?
sentences.zh: 至于查尔斯王子，嗯，我想他真的没什么可说的，不是吗？

sentences.en: And the Queen's people were basically saying, no, we can't, you know, we would never do this.
sentences.zh: 女王的人基本上在说，不，我们不能，你知道，我们永远不会这样做。

sentences.en: But the public opinion became so overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 但公众舆论变得如此势不可挡。

sentences.en: Today's statement from Buckingham Palace will be seen by some as a response to criticism of the royal establishment's handling of Diana's death.
sentences.zh: 白金汉宫今天的声明将被一些人视为对王室机构处理戴安娜之死方式的批评的回应。

sentences.en: Many had been contrasting the outpouring of popular grief and emotion with the silence and perceived detachment of senior members of the royal family.
sentences.zh: 许多人一直在将民众悲痛和情感的宣泄与王室高级成员的沉默和明显的疏离进行对比。

sentences.en: That they had to basically bow to public opinion and say that this woman had this profound impact on British society.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上不得不向公众舆论低头，承认这个女人对英国社会产生了深远的影响。

sentences.en: Well, I wonder, Sarah, if you think that the emotion and the vulnerability that Diana openly showed in that interview,
sentences.zh: 嗯，萨拉，我想知道你是否认为戴安娜在采访中公开表现出的情感和脆弱，

sentences.en: which is something that had been kind of anathema to the monarchy and kind of to British society until that moment, if that opened the door in a way for the public,
sentences.zh: 这在当时对君主制乃至英国社会来说都是一种禁忌，如果这在某种程度上为公众打开了大门，

sentences.en: for British people to be so open with their grief and their anger at the monarchy once Diana dies.
sentences.zh: 让英国人在戴安娜去世后能够如此公开地表达他们对君主制的悲伤和愤怒。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: I mean, right after the interview, opinion was really divided.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，采访刚结束时，舆论确实存在分歧。

sentences.en: But it wasn't until she was killed two years later that the lines were drawn between people who felt that she had been misunderstood and treated badly.
sentences.zh: 但直到两年后她去世，人们才划清了界限，那些认为她被误解和虐待的人站在了一边。

sentences.en: And if only anyone had listened to her, this wouldn't have happened.
sentences.zh: 如果当时有人听她的话，这一切就不会发生。

sentences.en: And the other voices really got washed out.
sentences.zh: 而其他的反对声音真的被淹没了。

sentences.en: And there was a big feeling of collective grief in the country and an opening of the floodgates to people to talk about their emotions.
sentences.zh: 全国上下有一种集体悲痛的感觉，人们谈论情感的闸门被打开了。

sentences.en: Not just sadness about what had happened to her, but also the sort of things she'd been talking about.
sentences.zh: 不仅是对她遭遇的悲伤，还有她一直在谈论的那类事情。

sentences.en: Mental illness, challenges in daily life, you know, people's struggles, getting help, seeking therapy, talking about your probleMs.
sentences.zh: 心理疾病、日常生活中的挑战，你知道，人们的挣扎、寻求帮助、寻求治疗、谈论你的问题。

sentences.en: All these things that they hadn't really been allowed to do before.
sentences.zh: 所有这些他们以前并不真正被允许做的事情。

sentences.en: So it feels like the image that Diana put forth in this unusual and very important interview with the BBC in some ways becomes the last word on this drama.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉戴安娜在这次与BBC进行的非同寻常且非常重要的采访中展现的形象，在某种程度上成为了这场闹剧的最后定论。

sentences.en: And the last word ends up kind of swinging public opinion toward Diana and away from the monarchy.
sentences.zh: 而这个最后定论最终将公众舆论转向了戴安娜，并远离了君主制。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And you saw that at her funeral where her brother got up and made a distinction between the way the royal family goes about things and the way Diana did and explicitly told her children,
sentences.zh: 你在她葬礼上就看到了这一点，当时她弟弟站出来，明确区分了王室行事的方式与戴安娜行事的方式，并明确告诉她的孩子们，

sentences.en: you know, we want to raise you in the way your mother would have raised you, which is different.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们想以你母亲会抚养你们的方式来抚养你们，这与王室的方式不同。

sentences.en: And then the question becomes, what effect does that have on her children?
sentences.zh: 于是问题就变成了，这对她的孩子们有什么影响？

sentences.en: Her children were being raised by their mother.
sentences.zh: 她的孩子们本应由他们的母亲抚养长大。

sentences.en: Their mother was dead.
sentences.zh: 但他们的母亲已经去世了。

sentences.en: But public opinion had come around to this notion that her way of doing it was right.
sentences.zh: 然而公众舆论已经转变为认为她那种行事方式才是正确的。

sentences.en: That her approach to the monarchy was right.
sentences.zh: 认为她对待君主制的方法是正确的。

sentences.en: That you should have compassion.
sentences.zh: 认为你应该有同情心。

sentences.en: That you should be emotional.
sentences.zh: 认为你应该有情感。

sentences.en: That you should be more like a normal person and less like, you know, a person living in an ivory tower far away from real people.
sentences.zh: 认为你应该更像一个普通人，而不是像那种住在远离现实人群的象牙塔里的人。

sentences.en: So they're raised with this image of their mother and the memory of their mother who they lost when they were young.
sentences.zh: 所以他们是在母亲的形象和他们年幼时失去的母亲的记忆中长大的。

sentences.en: I mean, Harry was only 12 years old and it really felt like his relationship with his mother was one of the driving forces in his life as he moved forward.
sentences.zh: 我是说，哈里当时只有12岁，他与母亲的关系似乎确实是他此后人生中主要的驱动力之一。

sentences.en: And her memory and what happened to her was very resonant with him when he set about finding a wife of his own.
sentences.zh: 当他着手寻找自己的妻子时，母亲的记忆以及发生在她身上的事对他产生了强烈的共鸣。

sentences.en: And interestingly enough, he had chosen someone who would end up emulating his mother in many ways.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，他选择的人最终在许多方面都效仿了他的母亲。

sentences.en: And together, when they themselves ran afoul of the customs of the royal family,
sentences.zh: 当他们自己与王室的习俗发生冲突时，

sentences.en: they sat down the way Diana had done for a major television interview and lobbed grenades at the royal family.
sentences.zh: 他们像戴安娜当年接受大型电视采访时那样坐下来，向王室投掷了“手榴弹”。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你可以在应用中免费使用第一个月。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Nearly 2 billion people around the globe watched their wedding.
sentences.zh: 全球有近20亿人观看了他们的婚礼。

sentences.en: From the outside, it looked like something out of a fairy tale and appeared to signal a new day for the modern British monarchy.
sentences.zh: 从外表看，这就像童话故事一样，似乎预示着现代英国君主制的新纪元。

sentences.en: This couple represents everything people can celebrate.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇代表了人们所能庆祝的一切。

sentences.en: It's a wonderful fairy tale.
sentences.zh: 这是一个美妙的童话。

sentences.en: They became one of the most talked about couples in the media.
sentences.zh: 他们成为了媒体谈论最多的夫妇之一。

sentences.en: Then in January 2020...
sentences.zh: 然后在2020年1月……

sentences.en: There's been an almost shockingly quick turnaround.
sentences.zh: 情况发生了令人震惊的快速转变。

sentences.en: Harry and Meghan stunned the world when they decided to step back as senior members of the royal family.
sentences.zh: 哈里和梅根决定退出王室高级成员身份，这震惊了世界。

sentences.en: Meghan seems to have moved from the nation's heroine to the nation's villain.
sentences.zh: 梅根似乎从国民英雄变成了国民公敌。

sentences.en: Okay, so Sarah, it is now 26 years later, and you are watching another bombshell interview with another wife of a member of the royal family.
sentences.zh: 好的，莎拉，现在26年过去了，你正在观看另一场由王室成员妻子带来的重磅采访。

sentences.en: Yes, and it was like history repeating itself,
sentences.zh: 是的，这就像历史重演，

sentences.en: which of course is what Harry said throughout the interview that he was most afraid of when it came to his wife and the royal family and the media,
sentences.zh: 当然，这也是哈里在整个采访中反复提到的，他最担心关于妻子、王室和媒体的事情，

sentences.en: that history would repeat itself.
sentences.zh: 就是历史会重演。

sentences.en: So it felt like deja vu to me.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，这感觉就像似曾相识。

sentences.en: Tonight, for the first time, they tell their story.
sentences.zh: 今晚，他们首次讲述了自己的故事。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈这个。

sentences.en: How do Meghan and Harry describe their experience with the royal family in this interview?
sentences.zh: 梅根和哈里在采访中是如何描述他们在王室的经历的？

sentences.en: And let's start with Meghan.
sentences.zh: 我们先从梅根开始。

sentences.en: The night before, I slept through the night.
sentences.zh: 前一天晚上，我睡得很安稳。

sentences.en: And then woke up and started listening to that song, Going to the Chapel.
sentences.zh: 醒来后，我开始听那首《Going to the Chapel》。

sentences.en: And just tried to make it fun and light.
sentences.zh: 只是想让一切变得有趣和轻松。

sentences.en: Well, she characterized it as a situation where she went in with every hope and every happiness being married to Harry.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她将其描述为一种情况：她怀着所有的希望和幸福嫁给了哈里。

sentences.en: But I think we were both really aware, even in advance of that, this wasn't our day.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们俩在那之前就非常清楚，这并不是属于我们的一天。

sentences.en: This was the day that was planned for the world.
sentences.zh: 这是为全世界计划的一天。

sentences.en: Everybody who gets married knows that you are really marrying the family, too.
sentences.zh: 每个结婚的人都知道，你实际上也是在与对方的家庭结婚。

sentences.en: But you weren't just marrying a family.
sentences.zh: 但你不仅仅是嫁给一个家庭。

sentences.en: You were marrying a 1,200-year-old institution.
sentences.zh: 你是在嫁给一个有1200年历史的机构。

sentences.en: You're marrying the monarchy.
sentences.zh: 你是在嫁给君主制。

sentences.en: What did you think it was going to be like?
sentences.zh: 你以为会是什么样？

sentences.en: I will say I went into it naively.
sentences.zh: 我得说，我当时太天真了。

sentences.en: But she described a family that was not sympathetic to her, that did not support her, that did not protect her.
sentences.zh: 但她描述了一个对她没有同情心、不支持她、也不保护她的家庭。

sentences.en: You know, there were several stories that compared headlines written about you to those written about Kate.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有几篇报道将关于你的头条新闻与关于凯特的头条新闻进行了对比。

sentences.en: Since you don't read things, let me just tell you what was said.
sentences.zh: 既然你不看这些东西，我就告诉你上面写了什么。

sentences.en: And she especially brought up the press and how badly the press treated her and how, in her words,
sentences.zh: 她特别提到了媒体，以及媒体对她有多么恶劣，用她的话说，

sentences.en: the royal family did nothing to correct the misapprehension that the press was propagating.
sentences.zh: 王室没有采取任何行动来纠正媒体传播的误解。

sentences.en: I came to understand that they weren't willing to tell the truth to protect me and my husband.
sentences.zh: 我开始明白，他们并不愿意为了保护我和我的丈夫而说出真相。

sentences.en: And it was horrifying and lonely and confusing and depressing.
sentences.zh: 那感觉既可怕、孤独，又令人困惑和沮丧。

sentences.en: And she talked about how she felt isolated.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了她感到多么孤立。

sentences.en: She felt constrained.
sentences.zh: 她感到受束缚。

sentences.en: So even, can I go and have lunch with my friends?
sentences.zh: 所以即使是，我能去和朋友吃午饭吗？

sentences.en: No, no, no, you're oversaturated.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不，你的曝光度太高了。

sentences.en: You're everywhere.
sentences.zh: 你无处不在。

sentences.en: It would be best for you to not go out to lunch with your friends.
sentences.zh: 你最好不要出去和朋友吃午饭。

sentences.en: I go, well, I haven't left the house in months.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，我已经几个月没出过门了。

sentences.en: And she talked as if she were someone who had no life of her own anymore, who had to completely conform to this institution.
sentences.zh: 她说话的样子就像一个再也没有自己生活的人，必须完全顺从这个机构。

sentences.en: I just didn't see a solution.
sentences.zh: 我只是看不到解决办法。

sentences.en: And I just didn't want to be alive anymore.
sentences.zh: 我只是不想再活下去了。

sentences.en: And that was a very clear and real and frightening, constant thought.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常清晰、真实且令人恐惧的持续念头。

sentences.en: And she said when she became more and more sad and depressed and suicidal, she asked for help and they said they couldn't help her.
sentences.zh: 她说当她变得越来越悲伤、沮丧并产生自杀念头时，她寻求帮助，但他们说他们帮不了她。

sentences.en: And I remember I went to the institution and I said that I needed to go somewhere to get help.
sentences.zh: 我记得我去找了那个机构，我说我需要去某个地方寻求帮助。

sentences.en: And I was told that I couldn't, that it wouldn't be good for the institution.
sentences.zh: 但我被告知我不能去，说这对机构不利。

sentences.en: And that, to me, was very similar to what Diana said when she talked about her mental health struggles and how this family was not sympathetic to it.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这与戴安娜谈论她的心理健康困境以及这个家庭对此缺乏同情心时所说的话非常相似。

sentences.en: And so listening to it, I sort of thought, you know, had they not changed at all in 26 years, they were still, still had the same approach.
sentences.zh: 所以听着这些，我心想，你知道，26年来他们一点都没变吗？他们依然采取同样的方式。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The parallels between Meghan and Diana from what you just described seem indisputable.
sentences.zh: 从你刚才描述的情况来看，梅根和戴安娜之间的相似之处似乎是无可争辩的。

sentences.en: I mean, almost startlingly so.
sentences.zh: 我是说，几乎令人震惊。

sentences.en: How explicitly in the interview do Meghan and Harry draw parallels to the situation with Diana?
sentences.zh: 梅根和哈里在采访中在多大程度上明确地将他们的情况与戴安娜的情况进行了类比？

sentences.en: Harry talked about it a lot.
sentences.zh: 哈里谈了很多。

sentences.en: You know, it felt like he was haunted by what had happened to his mother.
sentences.zh: 你知道，感觉他一直被母亲的遭遇所困扰。

sentences.en: The UK is my home.
sentences.zh: 英国是我的家。

sentences.en: So, yes, I've got my own relationship that goes back a long way with the media.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我和媒体有着很长一段历史的纠葛。

sentences.en: He focused more on the paparazzi element of it, on the tabloid element of it.
sentences.zh: 他更多地关注了狗仔队和八卦小报的因素。

sentences.en: You know, he talked about how badly his wife had been treated by the tabloids.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他谈到了他的妻子受到小报多么恶劣的对待。

sentences.en: I asked for calm from the British tabloids.
sentences.zh: 我请求英国小报保持冷静。

sentences.en: And he mentioned in the interview that he had pled with the tabloids on several occasions.
sentences.zh: 他在采访中提到，他曾多次恳求小报。

sentences.en: Once as a boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 一次是以男友的身份。

sentences.en: When he was dating Meghan.
sentences.zh: 当他和梅根约会时。

sentences.en: Once as a husband.
sentences.zh: 一次是以丈夫的身份。

sentences.en: When they were married.
sentences.zh: 当他们结婚时。

sentences.en: And then once as a father.
sentences.zh: 还有一次是以父亲的身份。

sentences.en: To back off, to be nicer, to stop it.
sentences.zh: 要求他们退后，友善一点，停止这一切。

sentences.en: And they wouldn't listen to him.
sentences.zh: 但他们不听他的。

sentences.en: So I think from his point of view, it was as if what happened to his mother, he was seeing repeated right in front of his eyes all over again.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为从他的角度来看，就好像他母亲身上发生的事，他正眼睁睁地看着这一切再次重演。

sentences.en: And he would have thought that he could do something about that history, that he could intervene to change it somehow.
sentences.zh: 他本以为自己能对那段历史做点什么，能干预并以某种方式改变它。

sentences.en: So when I asked the question, why did you leave?
sentences.zh: 所以当我问那个问题，你们为什么要离开？

sentences.en: The simplest answer is...
sentences.zh: 最简单的回答是……

sentences.en: Lack of support.
sentences.zh: 缺乏支持。

sentences.en: And lack of understanding.
sentences.zh: 以及缺乏理解。

sentences.en: And he was frustrated that he couldn't.
sentences.zh: 他对自己无能为力感到沮丧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And frustrated not just with the paparazzi, but with his own family.
sentences.zh: 不仅是对狗仔队感到沮丧，对他自己的家人也感到沮丧。

sentences.en: The element of the interview that stuck with me was when Harry said that at one point, his own father wasn't returning his phone calls.
sentences.zh: 采访中让我印象深刻的一点是，哈里说有一次，他父亲甚至不回他的电话。

sentences.en: And that he felt his entire family was being unresponsive in the face of a crisis in his own family.
sentences.zh: 他感到在自己家庭面临危机时，整个家族都毫无反应。

sentences.en: Yes, he was very upset about his family and how they had responded to Meghan, even from the beginning of their relationship.
sentences.zh: 是的，他对家人以及他们对梅根的反应感到非常难过，甚至从他们关系开始时就是如此。

sentences.en: He felt like they weren't open or sympathetic to her from the start.
sentences.zh: 他觉得他们从一开始就不接受她，也不体谅她。

sentences.en: And even more important, he felt that they weren't being supportive of the struggles that she was going through in terms of her mental health.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，他觉得他们不支持她在心理健康方面所经历的挣扎。

sentences.en: And in terms of combating these narratives that she said were in the paper and were so harmful to her.
sentences.zh: 以及在反击那些她说报纸上刊登的、对她伤害极大的叙事方面。

sentences.en: You know, they didn't go in and correct these stories against her, which they could well have done and they decided not to.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们没有出面纠正这些针对她的报道，他们本可以这样做，但他们决定不这样做。

sentences.en: And it really felt, watching that, that Harry was thinking about the past and hoping his family would have learned the lessons of what happened to his mother.
sentences.zh: 看着这些，真的感觉哈里在思考过去，希望他的家人能吸取他母亲遭遇的教训。

sentences.en: And what happened to her was that she also didn't have the support of the family.
sentences.zh: 而发生在她身上的事是，她同样没有得到家人的支持。

sentences.en: And it had been very hard on her.
sentences.zh: 这对她来说非常艰难。

sentences.en: And I think he was worried that Meghan would be abandoned in the same way as Diana was.
sentences.zh: 我想他担心梅根会像戴安娜一样被抛弃。

sentences.en: And of course, it had such terrible consequences, not just for his mother, but for him and his childhood.
sentences.zh: 当然，这不仅对他母亲，对他本人和他的童年都造成了可怕的后果。

sentences.en: And it's reverberated throughout his life.
sentences.zh: 这在他的一生中产生了回响。

sentences.en: And here, I think he felt was a chance to write a different sort of history.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我想他觉得这是一个书写不同历史的机会。

sentences.en: And the old history was coming back all over again.
sentences.zh: 但旧的历史又一次重演了。

sentences.en: So that makes me wonder, are Prince Harry and Meghan Markle right to see these parallels between her situation and Diana's?
sentences.zh: 这让我不禁想问，哈里王子和梅根·马克尔将她与戴安娜的情况进行类比是否正确？

sentences.en: I think they are.
sentences.zh: 我认为是正确的。

sentences.en: I mean, I think for Harry, it's one of the dominant principles in his thinking.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我认为对哈里来说，这是他思考中的主导原则之一。

sentences.en: I think he's animated in many ways by the memory of his mother and the desire to do better this time around.
sentences.zh: 我认为他在许多方面都是受母亲记忆的驱动，渴望这次能做得更好。

sentences.en: So I think for him, there was really no other way to look at this than as a parallel.
sentences.zh: 所以我想对他来说，除了将其视为一种类比，真的没有别的看法。

sentences.en: And I think it was, you know, to the extent that they're both pretty good at PR,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你知道，考虑到他们俩都很擅长公关，

sentences.en: I think it was a really smart way of doing the interview because it did raise all these issues.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种非常聪明的采访方式，因为它确实提出了所有这些问题。

sentences.en: It did make a historical through line, right, from this current interview back to this other one so many years prior.
sentences.zh: 它确实建立了一条历史脉络，对吧，从当前的采访回溯到多年前的那次采访。

sentences.en: And it did very neatly set up this dichotomy between the two of them on the one hand and maybe the forces of history.
sentences.zh: 它非常巧妙地在他们两人与历史力量之间建立了一种二分法。

sentences.en: And on the other hand, the royal family that refuses to change with the times.
sentences.zh: 而在另一方面，则是拒绝与时俱进的王室。

sentences.en: But of course, there are huge differences between this interview and the Diana interview.
sentences.zh: 但当然，这次采访与戴安娜的采访之间存在巨大的差异。

sentences.en: I mean, starting with the fact that Diana was all by herself.
sentences.zh: 我是说，首先戴安娜是孤身一人。

sentences.en: She was a single person going against a whole institution by herself and disapproved of by every single member of that family.
sentences.zh: 她是一个人对抗整个机构，且不被那个家庭的任何成员所认可。

sentences.en: And here in Meghan's case, we have her and Harry as a couple.
sentences.zh: 而在梅根的例子中，我们有她和哈里作为一对夫妇。

sentences.en: I mean, the really revolutionary thing about what's happened this time is that Harry is on his wife's side against his own family.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这次事件真正革命性的地方在于，哈里站在妻子这一边，对抗他自己的家人。

sentences.en: He's been steeped in that family and steeped in this notion of tradition and service and everybody does what the family wants.
sentences.zh: 他沉浸在那个家庭中，沉浸在传统和服务的观念中，每个人都做家庭想要做的事。

sentences.en: And yet he has chosen his wife over them.
sentences.zh: 然而他选择了妻子，而不是他们。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then, you know, the really important thing that we haven't mentioned yet, of course, is race.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，我们还没提到的一个非常重要的事情，当然就是种族。

sentences.en: Meghan's race was a factor in this from the very, very beginning when she was hit with a wall of racist abuse from the tabloid press when she was going out with Harry.
sentences.zh: 梅根的种族从一开始就是其中的一个因素，当时她与哈里交往时，遭到了小报媒体种族主义辱骂的围攻。

sentences.en: And that continued as a sort of underlying strain throughout the whole history of their relationship with the royal family.
sentences.zh: 这在他们与王室关系的整个历史中，一直作为一种潜在的压力持续存在。

sentences.en: In those months when I was pregnant, all around this same time, so we have in tandem the conversation of he won't be given security, he's not going to be given a title,
sentences.zh: 在我怀孕的那几个月里，就在同一时期，我们同时面临着关于他不会获得安保、不会获得头衔的谈话，

sentences.en: and also concerns and conversations about how dark his skin might be when he's born.
sentences.zh: 还有关于他出生时皮肤会有多黑的担忧和谈话。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: And then the worst part, the most disturbing part of the interview was when she talked, and then later Harry talked a little bit,
sentences.zh: 然后最糟糕的部分，采访中最令人不安的部分是当她谈到，后来哈里也谈到了一点，

sentences.en: about this notion of members of the royal family or a member of the royal family overtly asking, what about when you have a child?
sentences.zh: 关于王室成员或某位王室成员公开询问，当你有了孩子会怎么样？

sentences.en: You know, what color is the child going to be?
sentences.zh: 你知道，孩子会是什么颜色的？

sentences.en: As if there's this, you know, fear in the family that they won't have white children.
sentences.zh: 就好像家族里有一种恐惧，担心他们不会有白人后代。

sentences.en: Seeing Oprah's response when Oprah looked so incredulously, because it is, it's a horrible thing to hear from someone that people have spoken about them like that.
sentences.zh: 看到奥普拉在听到那些话时难以置信的反应，因为从别人嘴里听到有人那样谈论他们，这确实是一件可怕的事情。

sentences.en: You had described the reaction to Diana's interview as so forceful in all its forMs.
sentences.zh: 你曾形容人们对戴安娜那次采访的反应在各方面都非常强烈。

sentences.en: So how has the reaction been in the case of Meghan and Harry?
sentences.zh: 那么，梅根和哈里的情况又如何呢？

sentences.en: Well, the interesting thing is before the interview came out, the royal family was obviously worried about it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有趣的是，在采访播出之前，王室显然对此感到担忧。

sentences.en: So they were sort of preparing, but I don't think they were anything like prepared enough for what actually happened.
sentences.zh: 所以他们做了一些准备，但我认为他们根本没有为实际发生的事情做好充分准备。

sentences.en: And so for a day, there was no response.
sentences.zh: 因此，有一整天他们都没有做出回应。

sentences.en: I mean, they were sort of scrambling to see what would happen.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们当时有点手忙脚乱，不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: And what was so fascinating to me, having observed them for so long, is the statement they gave showed.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，观察他们这么久之后，最引人注目的是他们发表的声明所展现出的态度。

sentences.en: They realized they had to do something.
sentences.zh: 他们意识到自己必须采取行动。

sentences.en: And it said, we take what she said, what they said about the race issue very seriously.
sentences.zh: 声明中说，我们非常严肃地对待她所说的、他们所说的关于种族问题的内容。

sentences.en: And this is something we'll deal with in the family, but we're really sad to hear that they feel this way.
sentences.zh: 这是我们家族内部会处理的事情，但听到他们有这种感受，我们真的感到很难过。

sentences.en: So rather than doing what they might have done 20 years ago, 30 years ago, and just basically saying, you know, we don't accept any of this,
sentences.zh: 所以，他们没有像二三十年前那样，只是简单地说，你知道，我们不接受这一切，

sentences.en: and they decided to leave or whatever, they issued a really quite humble for them statement.
sentences.zh: 或者决定离开什么的，而是发表了一份对他们来说相当谦卑的声明。

sentences.en: It was pretty amazing.
sentences.zh: 这真是令人惊讶。

sentences.en: So you saw real humility in the response from the royal family?
sentences.zh: 所以你从王室的回应中看到了真正的谦卑？

sentences.en: Well, if it had come from anyone else, it wouldn't be humility.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果这话出自别人之口，那算不上谦卑。

sentences.en: But for them, that's humility.
sentences.zh: 但对他们来说，这就是谦卑。

sentences.en: I mean, any little thing they do, as I mentioned, that they haven't done before is like a seismic change for them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，正如我提到的，他们做的任何一点以前没做过的小事，对他们来说都像是地震般的改变。

sentences.en: They don't like doing things like this.
sentences.zh: 他们不喜欢做这样的事情。

sentences.en: So to break from their past behavior and to mention race like this, it reminds me of how Diana also forced the royal family through that interview
sentences.zh: 所以，打破过去的行事风格并像这样提及种族问题，这让我想起戴安娜当年也曾通过那次采访迫使王室

sentences.en: to confront something that they hadn't talked about before, this notion of mental health.
sentences.zh: 去面对他们以前从未谈论过的事情，即心理健康的概念。

sentences.en: And whether or not they believe what either of these women said, they were forced to tell the public that they were taking it seriously.
sentences.zh: 无论他们是否相信这两位女性所说的话，他们都被迫告诉公众，他们正在认真对待此事。

sentences.en: And that is a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这意义重大。

sentences.en: And it goes further than the monarchy, because the monarchy is sort of setting the tone here.
sentences.zh: 而且这不仅仅影响君主制，因为君主制在这里设定了基调。

sentences.en: It's the rest of society.
sentences.zh: 它影响的是整个社会。

sentences.en: I mean, it's as if they're sort of waiting for license to discuss these things in a new way, especially with this issue.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就好像人们在等待某种许可，以便以一种新的方式讨论这些事情，特别是在这个问题上。

sentences.en: I mean, this extraordinary thing happened on British TV.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，英国电视上发生了这件非同寻常的事情。

sentences.en: It doesn't really matter what I think of Meghan Markle.
sentences.zh: 我怎么看梅根·马克尔其实并不重要。

sentences.en: What matters is the damage that she is accused of doing to the royal family.
sentences.zh: 重要的是她被指控对王室造成的损害。

sentences.en: Where you have this sort of stuffy, old-fashioned establishment announcer named Piers Morgan, who'd been a huge, annoying critic of Meghan this whole time.
sentences.zh: 当时，像皮尔斯·摩根这样一位古板、老派的建制派主持人，一直以来都是梅根的头号讨厌的批评者。

sentences.en: On the issue of race, she has now got the whole of America, and the worst of the world, frankly,
sentences.zh: 在种族问题上，坦率地说，她现在让整个美国，乃至全世界最糟糕的部分，

sentences.en: looking upon the palace, the monarchy, the queen, everyone in the royal family, as a bunch of racists.
sentences.zh: 都把王宫、君主制、女王以及王室里的每个人看作是一群种族主义者。

sentences.en: He's doing his program on Tuesday morning, obviously discussing the interview,
sentences.zh: 他在周二早上主持节目时，显然在讨论那次采访，

sentences.en: when all of a sudden, another correspondent, Alex Beresford, who is biracial and was on the program to discuss all this,
sentences.zh: 突然间，另一位评论员亚历克斯·贝雷斯福德，他是混血儿，当时也在节目中讨论这一切，

sentences.en: says, hold on a second, Piers, you've been banging on about Meghan in the most nasty way for ages.
sentences.zh: 他说，等一下，皮尔斯，你已经以最恶劣的方式抨击梅根很久了。

sentences.en: And I understand that you don't like Meghan Markle.
sentences.zh: 我理解你不喜欢梅根·马克尔。

sentences.en: You've made it so clear a number of times on this program.
sentences.zh: 你在这个节目里已经多次表达得很清楚了。

sentences.en: We all know that you were friends with her, and then she cut you off, and you've never gotten over that.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道你曾经是她的朋友，后来她和你断交了，而你一直耿耿于怀。

sentences.en: She's entitled to cut you off if she wants to.
sentences.zh: 她有权在想断交时和你断交。

sentences.en: Has she said anything about you since she cut you off?
sentences.zh: 自从和你断交后，她说过你什么吗？

sentences.en: I don't think she has, but yet you continue to trash her.
sentences.zh: 我不认为她说过，但你却一直在诋毁她。

sentences.en: OK, I'm done with this.
sentences.zh: 好了，我受够了。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: No, sorry.
sentences.zh: 不，抱歉。

sentences.en: Do you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: That's pathetic.
sentences.zh: 这太可悲了。

sentences.en: You can trash me, maybe, not mine.
sentences.zh: 你可以诋毁我，或许，但不能诋毁她。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: See you later.
sentences.zh: 回头见。

sentences.en: I'm being...
sentences.zh: 我正在……

sentences.en: Sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: Can't do this.
sentences.zh: 没法录了。

sentences.en: This is absolutely diabolical behavior.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是恶魔般的行为。

sentences.en: So Piers Morgan, who's, you know, an influential, powerful, big, obnoxious voice in British TV, gets up and says, I've had it.
sentences.zh: 所以皮尔斯·摩根，你知道，作为英国电视界一位有影响力、强大、大嗓门且令人讨厌的人物，站起来说，我受够了。

sentences.en: I can't listen to this.
sentences.zh: 我听不下去了。

sentences.en: And he stalks off his own set of his own TV show.
sentences.zh: 然后他气冲冲地离开了自己主持的电视节目现场。

sentences.en: He wasn't even a gueSt.
sentences.zh: 他甚至不是嘉宾。

sentences.en: He's the hoSt.
sentences.zh: 他是主持人。

sentences.en: And he flounces out of the studio, sulks for a while, comes back in, and they finish the segment.
sentences.zh: 他怒气冲冲地走出摄影棚，生了一会儿闷气，又回来完成了剩下的环节。

sentences.en: But all hell is breaking loose.
sentences.zh: 但整个局面已经失控了。

sentences.en: People having watched him do this start complaining, and tens of thousands of complaints are lodged.
sentences.zh: 看过他这样做的观众开始投诉，数以万计的投诉接踵而至。

sentences.en: One of them apparently was from Meghan Markle herself, and he ends up being called in and yelled at by his boss.
sentences.zh: 其中一个显然来自梅根·马克尔本人，最终他被老板叫去训斥了一顿。

sentences.en: He won't apologize, and he's basically forced out of his job.
sentences.zh: 他不肯道歉，基本上被迫丢了工作。

sentences.en: And he quits.
sentences.zh: 于是他辞职了。

sentences.en: And that, I promise you, would never have happened two weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 我向你保证，这在两周前是绝不可能发生的。

sentences.en: In other words, this was an enough is enough moment, and it had been brought on by Meghan and by Harry doing that interview, saying what they said, and the monarchy signaling that
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这是一个忍无可忍的时刻，是由梅根和哈里那次采访引发的，他们说了那些话，而王室发出的信号表明

sentences.en: they understood the severity of it, and that trickling down to a major anchor in British
sentences.zh: 他们理解事情的严重性，这种影响渗透到了英国电视界的一位主要主播身上，

sentences.en: TV getting pushed out of his job.
sentences.zh: 导致他被挤出了工作岗位。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, what Meghan and Harry were saying is that a lot of the criticism they had been hearing had racial undertones, that a lot of stuff that had happened wasn't because Meghan
sentences.zh: 你知道，梅根和哈里所说的是，他们听到的许多批评都带有种族色彩，很多事情的发生并不是因为梅根

sentences.en: was just an outspoken woman, but because she was a woman of color.
sentences.zh: 只是一个直言不讳的女性，而是因为她是一位有色人种女性。

sentences.en: And that's the narrative that has started to become more prominent in the British conversation right now.
sentences.zh: 这就是现在在英国对话中开始变得更加突出的叙事。

sentences.en: And it's, again, it's a bit like what happened with Diana.
sentences.zh: 而且，这再次说明，这有点像戴安娜当年发生的事情。

sentences.en: Diana made it okay to talk about your feelings.
sentences.zh: 戴安娜让谈论自己的感受变得可以接受。

sentences.en: And they forced people to confront issues around race.
sentences.zh: 他们迫使人们面对种族问题。

sentences.en: So it had an impact beyond what you thought it would, just the way it was Diana.
sentences.zh: 所以它产生的影响超出了你的预期，就像戴安娜当年那样。

sentences.en: It was, you know, on one level, you could have thought of it as sort of internal family gossip and who really cares about the royal family, but it really changed society.
sentences.zh: 在某种层面上，你可能认为这只是家庭内部的八卦，谁真的在乎王室呢，但它确实改变了社会。

sentences.en: Sarah, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 莎拉，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, Michael.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 计划，这是一项旨在稳定经济并大幅扩大美国社会安全网的里程碑式立法。

sentences.zh: 在参议院本周早些时候通过后，该法案被众议院采纳。

sentences.zh: 没有一位共和党议员在两院中投下赞成票。

sentences.en: Representatives.
sentences.zh: 这是我们几十年来通过的最重要的立法之一。

sentences.zh: 投票结束后，众议院议长南希·佩洛西和参议院多数党领袖查克·舒默在国会大厦外举行了新闻发布会。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由尼娜·帕图克和西德尼·哈珀制作。
